scope: Static review of the R10 one-case external runner, its inputs, and no-Cargo preflight only. Do not run Cargo, Nextest, or tests.
expected_execution_scope: one selected test; no retries; test threads 1; Cargo jobs 2; no-tests=fail; 600-second process-group timeout; SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 5 seconds; 5-second post-SIGKILL close deadline; 8 MiB per raw child stream
review_checks: Verify all child binary, source, lock, cache, config, clone, and environment pins match the request.
Verify Rust 1.98.1 satisfies the crate rust-version and the runner pins the exact Cargo/rustc binaries.
Verify the exact filter plus --ignore-default-filter cannot select another test and zero selected tests fails.
Verify the runner starts only one direct child, captures stdout/stderr separately, has process-group timeout handling, finite post-SIGKILL close handling, and does not retry.
Verify target, HOME, TMPDIR, and result paths are external to the clone and fail closed if already present; there are no shell redirections to overwrite supervisor files.
Verify Git status preflight uses GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 and preflight mode does not invoke Cargo/Nextest tests or mutate the clone/cache.
